transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 678 Brooktondale Court?
Yeah, this is me at 678 Brooktondale Court—just me and two others, no one’s stuck inside or needing to leave alone, and the water’s not even in the house, so we’re all good here!
Thanks for confirming you’re all safe and accounted for. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Yeah, we’re all good here—three people total, and no one’s stuck inside or unable to get to the phone, and the water’s not even in the house, so no worries!

Nope, everyone here can move around just fine, no wheelchairs or oxygen or bedbound folks—just three of us, all good to go, no need for any special help.
Everyone here can move around just fine. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside at all, everything’s dry here, and all three of us are fine, no one’s stuck or needing help—just chillin’ inside, no rush.
All clear inside, everyone’s fine and settled. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, no truck, no boat, and I don’t have any free seats—everyone’s good here, just chilling, no need to rush or anything.
Got it, everyone’s good here, no rush. Let me read that back: 3 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—three of us here, no water in yet, and we’re all good, no one needs to leave alone or anything.
Thanks for confirming you’re all safe and accounted for. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
